title: Why You Think You're Smarter Than You Are
hook: Why does nobody explain Psychology #funny like this?
script: 70% of people overestimate their intelligence. It's the Dunning-Kruger effect. Unskilled individuals can't see their own incompetence. This bias makes them believe they're experts. That's why 70% overestimate their intelligence.
comment: Do you ever catch yourself overestimating your skills? 🤔
description:
Discover the Dunning-Kruger effect and why most people think they're smarter than they actually are. A fascinating psychology fact!
#AmazingFacts #PsychologyFacts #DunningKruger
